title: Bourguiba Mausoleum
scope: Standing Bourguiba Mausoleum in Monastir, with the central gold dome, two green cupolas, the white marble towers, side terraces and arcades, and the ornamental entrance fence.
limitations: The surveyed outlines and approach control horizontal location. The 25 m tower height is the published dimension. Main and side roof heights, cupola positions within the complex, deep rear elevations and the courtyard arcades are estimated.
The available exterior photograph looks along the approach. Fine gate lettering and decoration are expressed in simplified geometric forms. The surrounding cemetery is outside the model boundary.
Official regional elevation data support broad grades. Individual steps and local paving levels are estimated.
